name: @cetapod/react-native-smb
description: A React Native Nitro module exposing libsmb2 C++ library for SMB client functionality

scripts.build:ios: npm run build:libsmb2 && npm run build:xcframework
scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run build:ios
scripts.clean:build: rm -rf ios/ && cd libsmb2 && rm -rf build/
scripts.setup:example: npm run build:full && cd example && npm install
scripts.example: npm run setup:example && cd example && npm run ios
scripts.example:prebuild: npm run setup:example && cd example && npm run prebuild:ios

author: Cetapod open source <open-source@cetapod.com>
